sources.title: GitHub - SparkAudio/Spark-TTS: Spark-TTS Inference Code
sources.snippet: Spark-TTS is an advanced text-to-speech system that uses the power of large language models (LLM) for highly accurate and natural-sounding voice synthesis. It is designed to be efficient, flexible, and powerful for both research and production use.

sources.title: Spark-TTS
sources.snippet: 8 Fuxi AI Lab, NetEase, Inc GitHub Repo | Hugging Face Spark-TTS, a novel system built upon our proposed BiCodec, a single-stream speech codec that strategically decomposes speech into two complementary token types: low-bitrate semantic tokens for linguistic content and fixed-length global tokens for speaker-specific attributes.
